Mô tả Công việc

COMPANY BACKGROUND/CULTURE

Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000+ employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world. We are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.

JOB DESCRIPTION

• Technical solution consultant for customer (IP/Datacom/FTTx).

• Responsible for designing, implementing and troubleshooting of Huawei Enterprise Networking products and solutions.

• Enable and supervise Huawei authorized partners on how to test, design, implement and maintain Huawei Enterprise Service products integrated into their solutions.

• Work closely and proactively with Presales Sales team to ensure early engagement to sales opportunities and bid creation such as Prove of Concept (POC) testing, technical clarification, etc.

Yêu Cầu Công Việc

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Telecommunication or related fields.

• Minimum 2 years of working experience in telecommunication industry hands-on aftersales experience in enterprise services for IT vendors, system integrators or service providers with a proven track record.

• In-depth knowledge and practical experience in Networking technology such LAN, WLAN, WAN and Security

• Valid CCIE, HCIE or equivalent certificate is preferred.

• Customer-oriented, self-motivated and capable of working under pressure

• Good command in English.

WORKING TIME AND BENEFITS

·        Monday to Friday (08:30-18:00).

·        Short term and long-term award

·        Huawei online and offline aboard training.

·        Participating in full insurance benefits (health insurance, social insurance, unemployment insurance), the company supports 24/24 accident insurance and health care insurance for employees.

·        Professional working environment, multinational company, good career development opportunities. Cultural and sports activities, taking care of employees' health and life are organized periodically...

·        Salary: negotiable.
